content:
sam: Heads-up — noticed ~5 tenants in the last hour appear as v2 in the console badge but are still routed to v1. Happens when the X-Client-Version header is missing/padded. Anyone seen this before?
alyssa: ugh. saw one earlier too. can you paste a sample request id?
sam: req id 01FTR9X9Y2QZ7H1K0B4A0 — attached logs show header empty + route decision went to /v1 backend.
kevin: quick note: our header coercion logic strips whitespace and then falls back to default-version when header empty. edge if header present but blank -> we treat as explicit v2 in console lineage but routing code checks parsed enum and falls back to v1. mismatch between console attribution and routing.
marta: so console is reading raw header string, routing uses parsed enum. that explains badge but not real routing. console shows correct raw header "" -> displays v2 badge due to loose match rule.
eng-sre-bot: [alert] 5 routing-entropy anomalies detected in routing-service cluster-a (metric: version_switch_mismatch).
jordan: here's a minimal repro curl i used: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Client-Version: \"\"" $API_URL/generate
```
server responds via v1 pool.
kevin: fix options: 1) make console read the canonical parsed version (preferred), 2) relax routing check to prefer console-style raw-string match, 3) short term: server-side tolerant fallback that treats blank as header-absent not explicit v2.
sam: prefer option 1 + small server patch for safety. we need telemetry to catch regressions though.
alyssa: I'll add a telemetry event: version_header_raw vs version_header_parsed and emit a mismatch tag. also add a sampling flag to capture full headers for 0.1% of traffic.
kevin: PR ready for the tolerant fallback: https://git.internal/r/redwood/routing/pulls/4123 (small patch, 2 lines). includes unit test.
jordan: ops-side quickpatch to flip sticky routing to prefer pinned-phase for affected tenants: infra cli -> `infra set route-affinity --policy sticky-prefer-pinned --tenants tmp-cohort` (can run as emergency).
marta: I'll annotate the console with a warning banner: "Known header parsing mismatch; routing may differ until patch applied" and wire a dashboard card pointing to version_switch_mismatch. Dashboard link: https://dash.internal/d/route-mismatch
sam: plan: alyssa adds telemetry sampling (ETA 30m), kevin merges tolerant fallback (ETA 45m), marta posts banner + dashboard (ETA 20m), jordan to coordinate emergency infra CLI if we see >20 tenants impacted. I'll ping support and CS for any confused customers. 
alyssa: logging note: add a structured field `version_header_mismatch: true` to make downstream query easier.
kevin: merging PR now. running smoke tests.
eng-sre-bot: [deploy] routing-service patch deployed to canary (node-set canary-3) at 1749876585.
sam: smoke looked clean on canary. roll to prod after 1 hour of canary monitoring unless we see new anomalies. updating incident thread. :thumbsup:
__notes: single-thread slack format: messages prefixed by sender. no title field as per agents.md. timestamps are in metadata only.
